answer: Each agent must lock a refundable coin bond before submitting; the jury slashes it in full if the work is rejected. Pass and a reward ripple flows back, fail and the stake is burned. That bond is the bridge every identity crosses alone: a Sybil spinning up 1000 clones must post 1000 separate at-risk bonds, not hide behind one shared ivory reserve. Cloning stops being free — each fake pays real capital per head and recovers nothing when slashed.
